title: uwf-world-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Undertaker

won.source: Billed as champion on the promotion's own founding title list, 20 June 2008.

note: No document read records how or when the title passed from Undertaker to CM Punk.

title: uwf-world-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: CM Punk

won.source: Billed as champion and defending against Undertaker at Summer Party, 28 September 2008.

note: Retained against Undertaker at Summer Party, the latest document naming a champion for this specific title read.

title: uwf-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Jeff Hardy

won.source: Billed as champion and defending against Edge at Summer Party, 28 September 2008.

note: No document read records how or when the title passed from Hardy to John Cena.

title: uwf-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: John Cena

won.source: Billed as champion on the Sacrifice brand's own champions list (February 2009) and referred to as champion throughout Sacrifice #1, 24 February 2009.

note: Still billed champion at Sacrifice #1's own close, with Edge newly confirmed as number-one contender for a promised BlockDown title match not captured.

title: uwf-tag-team-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Paul London & Brian Kendrick

won.source: Billed as champions and defending against Cade & Murdoch at Summer Party, 28 September 2008.

note: No document read records how or when the titles passed from London & Kendrick to John Morrison & The Miz.

title: uwf-tag-team-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: John Morrison & The Miz

won.source: Billed in-story as having won the titles at the promotion's own New Years Party (January 2009, not independently captured); confirmed still champions, retaining against Jesse & Festus, on Sacrifice #1, 24 February 2009.

note: Earned a TLC Tornado tag rematch against Jesse & Festus for the following week, not captured.

title: uwf-cruiserweight-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Shannon Moore

won.source: Won from Jimmy Wang Yang on WAR #16, 5 April 2009.

note: The latest document naming a champion for this title read.

title: uwf-cruiserweight-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Jimmy Wang Yang

won.source: Billed as champion on the promotion's own founding title list, 20 June 2008; still billed champion entering WAR #16, 5 April 2009, after an undocumented intervening reign by Gregory Helms per a Sacrifice #1 dialogue exchange.

note: Lost the title to Shannon Moore on WAR #16.

title: uwf-hardcore-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Finlay

won.source: Billed as champion and defending in a Six-Way match on WAR #7, 8 September 2008.

note: No document read records how or when the title passed from Finlay to King Booker.

title: uwf-hardcore-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: King Booker

won.source: Billed as champion on the Sacrifice brand's own champions list, current as of its own capture in February 2009.

note: The latest document naming a champion for this title read.

title: uwf-intercontinental-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Rey Mysterio

won.source: Billed as champion, and attacked by his own number-one contender Randy Orton, on WAR #7, 8 September 2008; retained against Orton at Summer Party in an I Quit match.

note: No document read records how or when the title passed from Mysterio to Randy Orton.

title: uwf-intercontinental-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Randy Orton

won.source: Billed as champion on the Sacrifice brand's own champions list, current as of its own capture in February 2009; a rematch against Mysterio is booked for the following week on Sacrifice #1.

note: The latest document naming a champion for this title read; the promised rematch was not captured.

title: uwf-x-division-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Kofi Kingston

won.source: Billed as champion on the Sacrifice brand's own champions list, consistent with (but not independently confirmed by) his own semi-final win at Sacrifice #1; the tournament final against Gregory Helms was not captured.

note: The only document naming a champion for this newly-introduced title read.

title: uwf-divas-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Melina

won.source: Billed as champion on the promotion's own founding title list, 20 June 2008.

note: Still billed champion and challenged by Natalya for a match "next week" on WAR #16, the latest document naming a champion for this specific title read.

title: uwf-womens-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Beth Phoenix

won.source: Won by climbing the ladder and claiming the belt for her own team in the 8-Diva Tag Team Ladder match at Summer Party, 28 September 2008.

note: Still billed champion on the Sacrifice brand's own later champions list (February 2009), and referred to in a WAR #16 commentary tease as defending against Candice Michelle.

title: uwf-womens-championship-pwr-fed-2008
label: Michelle McCool

won.source: Billed as champion and defending, by disqualification, against Candice Michelle on WAR #7, 8 September 2008.

note: Lost the title to Beth Phoenix's own team in the 8-Diva Tag Team Ladder match at Summer Party.
